Created [muon envelope input](docs/design/inputs/DES-003-muon-envelope-input.md).

Key findings:

- ODD barrel: **r = 3.536–6.762 m**, **|z| ≤ 7.200 m**.
- Endcaps: **r = 0.54073–7.000 m**, **|z| = 7.200–10.270 m**.
- These are parent-volume reservations, not sensitive coverage.
- Recommend retaining these as a provisional comparison envelope; distinguish tracker-assisted muon identification from standalone spectrometry.
- External spectrometry requires a credible magnet/return structure, field integrals and material allocation.

Included precise ODD factory/XML locators, historical ATLAS/CMS evidence, upgrade TDR passages, interface ownership and follow-up questions. No production changes or simulation performed. Session validation: **22 records passed**.
